entities.name: Quintus Cassius Longinus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Quintus Cassius Longinus, a Roman governor, played a pivotal role in shaping the trajectory of Hispania during the late Republic.

As the brother or cousin of Cassius, Quintus Cassius Longinus was a key figure in the struggle against Caesar's rule, serving as a governor in Hispania and navigating the complexities of Roman politics.

His actions had significant consequences, influencing the fate of the Roman Empire and the course of history in the region.

Despite his relatively minor stature compared to other Roman leaders, Quintus Cassius Longinus's legacy is a testament to the enduring impact of the Roman Empire on the modern world.

'In Hispania, the blood of patriots was shed by the very men who would one day shape the fate of Rome.'
